'''Sergey Konstantinovich Gulev''' ({{langx|ru|Сергей Константинович Гулев}}; born November 29, 1958) is a [[Russians|Russian]] [[Climate change|climate]] scientist. He is head of the ocean-atmosphere interaction laboratory at the [[Shirshov Institute of Oceanology|Shirshov Institute of Oceanology, Russian Academy of Sciences]] and is a professor of oceanology and meteorology at [[Moscow State University]].<ref name="2018-06-06">{{cite web |title=IORAS, Physics Department |url=https://ioran.ocean.ru/en/index.php?option=com_k2&view=item&id=62:sea-air-interaction-and-climate-laboratory-sail&Itemid=142 |website=ocean.ru}}</ref> In 2011, he was elected as a Corresponding Member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Congratulations Upon the Election to the Russian Academy of Sciences |url=https://www.wcrp-climate.org/documents/WCRPnews_06012012.pdf |website=World Climate Research Programme |accessdate=2018-06-06}}</ref>

He served as a lead author of the 2007 and 2014 [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change|IPCC]] Scientific Assessment Reports on Climate Change, and is currently (as of 2018) coordinating lead author in the forthcoming Sixth Assessment Report.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ipcc.ch/report/authors/authors.php?q=35&p=2 |website=IPCC |accessdate=2018-06-12 |title=Sixth Assessment Report: Working Group 1 Lead Author Biographies}}</ref>

== Awards ==

He was a [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation|Humboldt Fellow]] 1992/1993 at the [[Institut für Meereskunde Kiel]], now called [[GEOMAR Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research Kiel]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/newsletter-1-2009-7-en.html |website=Humboldt Foundation |accessdate=2018-06-12|title=Our Climate Forecasts Will Be More Accurate and Longer Term}}</ref>
